name: Adjudication hours per decided case (completion rate)
definition: Average staff "touch time" in hours needed to decide one request of a given type, as estimated by the programme authority for fee setting or staffing. Not the time applicants wait (see processing_time_months).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (USCIS completion rates in the EB-5 fee rules). Use breakdown form=.

name: Applications for an agent licence
definition: Applications received by a programme authority from firms seeking a licence or selection as an agent (intermediary/marketing agent or due-diligence agent) in a call or period. Use breakdown category= for the type of agent.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 (Montenegro's 3 Jan 2019 calls for intermediary and due-diligence agents). Complements agents_licensed.

name: Licensed programme agents
definition: Number of agents or intermediaries (persons or firms, as the source counts them) licensed or accredited by the programme authority to submit applications, at a date. Use breakdown category= for the type of firm the source gives.
notes: proposed by research:extract-hun-mlt-eur. proposed by extract-hun-mlt-eur for Malta's IIP accredited persons/agents (OR-GCES reports 2014 and 2019-2020).

name: Number of nationalities among applicants
definition: Number of distinct nationalities among a programme's applicants (or grantees, as the source says) in a period, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for the MAC Tier 1 (Investor) report (2014), para 2.47 (71 nationalities).

name: Share of applicants or approved applicants by nationality
definition: Percentage of a programme's applicants (or approved main applicants, as stated in notes) who hold a given nationality, in a period. Use breakdown nationality=ISO3.
notes: proposed by research:europe-rest. Used when sources give only percentages, not counts. Notes must say whether the base is applications or approvals.

name: Share of applicants by personal characteristic or investment choice
definition: Percentage of a programme's main applicants (submitted, approved or naturalised, as stated in notes) in a group the source defines other than nationality: sex, number of citizenships held, employment status, education level, age bracket, or investment option chosen. Use breakdown sex=, category= or route=; applicant= says which stage (main = applications submitted, naturalised_main = naturalised).
notes: proposed by research:extract-hun-mlt-eur. proposed by extract-hun-mlt-eur for the Maltese regulator's tables (OR-GCES 2019-2020 report, Tables 4, 6, 17, 18, 20, 21). Nationality and region shares stay in applicant_nationality_share.

name: Applications approved
definition: Applications approved in a period. First-time (initial) applications unless noted; renewals excluded.

name: Approved applications by year filed
definition: Applications that were eventually approved, counted by the year in which they were filed (not the year of approval). Excludes applications rejected, withdrawn or pending.
notes: added by research:cyprus. Cyprus Audit Office chart of the 3,517 approved investor applications. Not comparable with applications_received. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Applications approved in principle
definition: Applications given approval in principle (conditional approval before the investment is made and the visa granted). Say in notes whether the figure is the current stock at a date or a cumulative count including later grants.
notes: proposed by research:oceania. New Zealand Active Investor Plus reports both forms in different versions of its page.

name: Application grant rate
definition: Grants as a percentage of decisions or of all finalisations (grants, refusals and withdrawals) in a period, as printed by the source; notes give the base. Never calculated by us. Companion to cbi_rejection_rate and withdrawal_rate.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the "Grant Rate" rows of the Australian Migration Program reports (BIIP comparison tables, 2018-19 to 2024-25 reports).

name: Applications lapsed
definition: Applications that lapsed (closed without a decision on the merits, as the source classifies them, separately from withdrawals) in a period. Companion to applications_withdrawn.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for the UK entry clearance table vi_01_q (Tier 1 - Investors: Applications, Resolved, Granted, Refused, Withdrawn, Lapsed).

name: Applications pending
definition: Applications of main applicants (initial and renewal unless noted) filed but not yet decided at a date. A stock on a date: all pending files regardless of the year they were filed.
notes: added by research:greece. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Applications pending, incl. family members
definition: Applications of main applicants and family members filed but not yet decided at a date
notes: added by research:greece. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Applications processed
definition: Applications decided (approved plus denied) in a period, regardless of when filed
notes: added by research:grenada. Can exceed applications received when backlogs are cleared Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Applications received
definition: Applications filed in a period (main applicants unless noted). Counts first-time (initial) applications; renewals and family members' own files are excluded unless noted.

name: Change in applications received (percent, as stated)
definition: Percentage change in a programme's applications between a period and an earlier period, as stated by the source when it gives no counts. Never calculated by us. Notes say the comparison period and what is counted.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for the St Kitts CIU Chairman's December 2025 update ('A 169% increase in applications'). Where counts are printed, record them as applications_received instead.

name: Growth in applications received
definition: Average annual percentage growth in applications received over a period, as stated or projected by the source (never calculated by us).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (USCIS VPC: 39% a year since FY2008; 3.3% projected).

name: Applications rejected
definition: Applications denied in a period. First-time (initial) applications unless noted; renewals excluded.

name: Applications rejected, by year filed
definition: Applications filed in a period (year or month of filing) that had been rejected by the date of the source, counted by the period in which they were filed, not the period of the decision. First-time (initial) applications unless the breakdown says permit_type=renewal.
notes: proposed by research:extract-grc. added by extract-grc for the Greek Ministry of Migration annex tables (Πίνακας 13α/13β). Figures for recent filing periods grow as pending files are decided.

name: Applications withdrawn
definition: Applications withdrawn by the applicant (or deemed withdrawn, e.g. investment not made in time) in a period, before a decision.
notes: added by research:closed-west. Proposed by research:closed-west (Ireland). Not added as rows yet: the only figure found is 'approximately 500' for 2012-2022 (answer of 28 Feb 2023). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Applications withdrawn or revoked, by year filed
definition: Applications filed in a period that had been withdrawn or revoked ("ανακλήσεις") by the date of the source, counted by the period in which they were filed. First-time applications unless the breakdown says permit_type=renewal.
notes: proposed by research:extract-grc. added by extract-grc. The Greek tables do not define "ΑΝΑΚΛΗΣΕΙΣ"; it can mean withdrawal of the application or revocation of the decision.

name: Applications withdrawn or declined (combined)
definition: Applications that ended without approval, where the source reports withdrawals and refusals together, in a period.
notes: proposed by research:oceania. Use applications_rejected / applications_withdrawn when the source splits them.

name: Approvals-in-principle outstanding (stock)
definition: Applications that hold an approval-in-principle (permission to enter and make the qualifying investment) but have not yet received final/formal approval, counted at a date. A stock, not a running total of approvals-in-principle ever granted.
notes: proposed by research:hong-kong-taiwan. Hong Kong CIES: the Immigration Department's 'Approval-in-principle granted' column. Cumulative approvals-in-principle granted (e.g. New CIES) go in applications_approved with breakdown stage=approval_in_principle.

name: Bank client relationships refused or ended over programme links
definition: Client relationships linked to the programme that banks refused to open (category=refused) or terminated (category=terminated) in a period, as reported by the supervisor or banks.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos report ch. 12).

name: Programme cases meeting a stated condition (review of files)
definition: Number of programme cases (applications or approved investors, as the source counts them) that a review, audit or evaluation of case files found to meet a stated programme condition, over the period the review covers. Use breakdown category= for the condition.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish Department of Justice review of investment-based naturalisation (Feb 1998), Appendices B and D, which give yes/no counts per condition. Companion to cases_not_meeting_condition.

name: Programme cases not meeting a stated condition (review of files)
definition: Number of programme cases that a review, audit or evaluation of case files found NOT to meet (or found no evidence for) a stated programme condition, over the period the review covers. Use breakdown category= for the condition.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1; companion to cases_meeting_condition.

name: Programme case files under external inquiry
definition: Number of programme cases (persons or applications, as the source counts them) whose files are held by, or referred to, a tribunal, court, police, prosecutor or other external inquiry, at a date. Not a finding of wrongdoing; findings go in irregular_naturalisations_detected.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish answer of 14 Dec 2004: files on 128 persons naturalised under the investment scheme were with the Moriarty tribunal.

name: Balance of a CBI-related government account
definition: Balance at a date of a government account or fund held for, or named after, a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme or its unit (e.g. a CIU deposit or contingency account), as listed in public accounts or by the source. Use breakdown category= for the account.
notes: proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut (St. Kitts 2016 audit report, inactive deposit accounts "CIU Contingency Account" and "Office of the Prime Minister/CIU"). Narrower savings funds keep cbi_contingency_fund_balance.

name: Donations by programme applicants to local entities
definition: Donations made by programme applicants (as an eligibility condition or voluntarily) to local charities, NGOs, cultural, sport or other entities in a period, as reported by the programme authority. Unit is the currency for amounts, or 'donations' for the number of donations.
notes: proposed by research:extract-hun-mlt-eur. proposed by extract-hun-mlt-eur for Malta IIP donations (OR-GCES 2019-2020 report, Table 28 and Appendix B). Not the government development-fund contribution.

name: CBI government bond purchases
definition: Value of government bonds purchased by CBI applicants in a period
notes: added by research:saint-lucia. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI inflows recorded in the capital account, share of GDP
definition: CBI-related inflows recorded in the balance-of-payments capital account (as defined by the IMF source) divided by GDP
notes: added by research:st-kitts-nevis. Distinct from budgetary CBI fees recorded as services exports Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI-funded contingency fund balance
definition: Balance of a government savings/contingency fund financed from CBI receipts (e.g. Grenada's 10% of NTF receipts held at the ECCB), at a date
notes: added by research:grenada. Stock, not flow; period is an as-of date Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: People covered by listed fund contributions
definition: Number of people (main applicants and dependants) covered by the fund contributions a programme unit lists for a period, as printed in the list's total row.
notes: proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg. Antigua CIU NDF contribution lists print persons and dollars in the total row.

name: CBI contributions collected
definition: Donations/contributions paid by applicants into the government's CBI or development fund in a period, gross (before any share kept by the CBI unit), excluding property purchases, investments and fees
notes: added by research:antigua-barbuda. Same definition as proposed in the Malta inbox file. For Antigua: NDF contributions listed in CIU six-monthly reports. Reviewed 2026-09-28. Merged with cbi_fund_contributions (research:saint-lucia): in Saint Lucia the CIU keeps 20% and remits 80%, so check each row's notes for gross or net.

name: Number of fund contributions (donations) received
definition: Number of monetary investments (donations) into a government CBI fund received in a period, or budgeted, as printed by the programme unit. A count of contributions, not of people.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the Saint Lucia CIU 2017/18 report (111 donations received vs 200 budgeted).

name: Fund contributions held by the CBI unit pending remittance
definition: Fund contributions (donations) collected by the CBI unit but not yet paid over to the government or the national fund at a date (or added to that balance in a period), as stated in the unit's accounts.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the Saint Lucia CIU accounts (NEF money held in trust at year end, 2020-2025).

name: CBI contributions as a share of GDP
definition: cbi_contributions divided by nominal GDP, as calculated by the source
notes: added by research:malta. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Fund contributions approved but not yet collected
definition: Gross fund contributions (donations) owed by applicants whose citizenship has been approved but which had not been collected at a date, as stated by the programme unit. A stock at a date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the Saint Lucia CIU 2017/18 report (EC$20,479,500 outstanding at 31 March 2018).

name: Court award relating to CBI money
definition: Amount a court orders a party to pay the state in connection with CBI proceeds
notes: added by research:historical. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI dividend paid to citizens
definition: Cash payments to a country's citizens or residents financed from, and named after, citizenship-by-investment revenue (e.g. St. Kitts and Nevis "Citizenship by Investment Dividend"), in a period. Status budget for appropriations, actual for recorded spending.
notes: proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for the St. Kitts audit reports 2022-2023.

name: CBI dividend paid to citizens, share of GDP
definition: cbi_dividend_payout divided by GDP, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF St Kitts 2025 Article IV Table 2 (row "CBI dividend").

name: People receiving a CBI dividend
definition: Number of people who received a cash payment financed from, and named after, citizenship-by-investment revenue (e.g. the St. Kitts and Nevis 'CBI dividend') in a payment round or period, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna2. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna2 for the St Kitts 2024 Budget Address ('about 17,500 individuals in its inaugural round'). Companion to cbi_dividend_payout (amount).

name: CBI money due to the government (calculated)
definition: Amount of CBI money that a programme's statistics calculate as due to the government from applications approved in a period (budget fees and the government's share of fund contributions, e.g. savings and grants for capital spending), before it is collected or transferred. As defined by the source; use breakdown category= for its parts.
notes: proposed by research:extract-grd-lca-dma-atg. Proposed by extract-grd-lca-dma-atg for Grenada's Ministry of Finance CBI statistics ('Amounts Due to Government', 2022; 'Earmarked for general government financing', 2019, a running total). Not cash: compare cbi_transfers_to_government.

name: Programme money held in applicants' escrow accounts
definition: Money deposited by programme applicants in escrow accounts at a date and not yet released to the project, fund or government (typically for applications still being decided), as stated by the source. Use breakdown route= for the purpose of the deposit.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 for the Montenegrin status reports of 2026 (escrow balances for tourism projects and for the Innovation Fund). Not a government account, so not cbi_account_balance.

name: CBI fees collected by the programme unit
definition: Processing, due diligence, passport and agent licence fees collected by the CBI unit in a period, excluding donations and investments
notes: added by research:antigua-barbuda. Antigua CIU operating account; not the same as cbi_fiscal_revenue. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI revenue to government
definition: CBI money counted as government revenue in the fiscal accounts (usually fund contributions and fees, not real-estate purchases)

name: Change in CBI revenue to government (percent)
definition: Year-on-year percentage change in CBI revenue to government, as printed by the source
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-vut1. Use only when the source prints the change; never computed from levels. Companion to cbi_fiscal_revenue.

name: Share of CBI revenue from one component
definition: Percentage of a CBI unit's collections (as recorded in the fiscal accounts) in a period that came from one component (e.g. contributions, application fees, due diligence fees), as stated by the source. Use breakdown category= for the component.
notes: proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for the St. Kitts 2016 audit report, which gives only a share (92% "Citizenship by Investment fees"). Where amounts are printed, record them as cbi_fiscal_revenue with category= instead.

name: CBI money as a share of government expenditure
definition: CBI money received by the government in a period divided by total government expenditure in that period, as calculated by the source (how much of spending CBI receipts paid for).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for the St Kitts 2023 Budget Address ('funded 63.5 percent of the Government's Total Expenditure' in 2021). Different denominator from cbi_fiscal_revenue_pct_revenue.

name: CBI revenue to government as a share of GDP
definition: cbi_fiscal_revenue divided by nominal GDP

name: CBI share of non-tax revenue
definition: CBI money counted as government revenue in a period divided by the government's non-tax revenue in that period, as stated by the source. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-atg2. Proposed by extract-cbi-atg2 for Antigua and Barbuda budget speeches ('nearly 60 per cent of non-tax revenue'). Kept apart from cbi_fiscal_revenue_pct_revenue because non-tax revenue is a much smaller denominator than total revenue.

name: CBI receipts as a share of operating cash receipts
definition: CBI money collected by the government (e.g. CIU fees) divided by total receipts from operating activities in the government cash flow statement, as calculated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for the St. Kitts audit reports (2018: 32%, 2019: 36%). Different denominator from cbi_fiscal_revenue_pct_revenue (recurrent or total revenue).

name: CBI share of government revenue
definition: cbi_fiscal_revenue divided by total government revenue (with or without grants: see notes)

name: Money credited to a CBI-financed account or fund
definition: Money credited in a period to an account or fund financed by a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, as listed by the programme unit (contributions and any other receipts). Use breakdown category= for the account.
notes: proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg (Antigua NDF monthly credits 2016; Renewable Energy Escrow credits). Not the same as cbi_contributions, which counts only applicant donations.

name: Losses of a CBI-financed fund
definition: Amount of a fund financed by citizenship sales reported lost, written off or missing (e.g. Tonga Trust Fund investment losses)
notes: added by research:historical. Stock-like, usually cumulative to a date; often only press figures Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Payments out of a CBI-financed account or fund
definition: Money paid out in a period from an account or fund financed by a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme (e.g. the CBI unit's operating account, a national development fund, an escrow fund), as listed by the programme unit. Use breakdown category= for the account.
notes: proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg for the Antigua CIU six-monthly reports (operating-account disbursements approved by Cabinet, NDF payments, Renewable Energy Escrow payments).

name: Money recovered for a CBI-financed fund
definition: Amounts recovered through settlements or court awards for losses of a fund financed by citizenship sales
notes: added by research:historical. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Public facilities built with programme money
definition: Number of public facilities (e.g. health centres, schools) built or completed with money from a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, as stated by the source. Use breakdown category= for the type of facility. Homes are counted in cbi_funded_housing_units.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for Dominica budget addresses (e.g. twelve Health and Wellness Centres completed with CBI funding, 2022/23 address).

name: Homes built with programme money
definition: Number of dwellings (houses or residential units) built, under construction, contracted or handed over with money from a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, as stated by the source. Use breakdown category= for the site or stage.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for Dominica, where post-hurricane housing was built under the CBI programme (Montreal Management Consultants, Bellevue Chopin and other sites). Not the same as properties bought by applicants (properties_acquired_for_cbi).

name: Spending on a CBI-financed public project, percent of GDP
definition: Estimated total cost of, or spending in a period on, a public project that the source says is financed (wholly or mainly) with citizenship- or residence-by-investment revenue, as a percentage of GDP, as stated by the source. Use breakdown category= for the project; notes say whether it is the total cost or a period outlay.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica reports on the new international airport, "financed through CBI resources" (estimated cost 65 percent of GDP in the 2021 Article IV, 59 percent of 2022 GDP in the 2023 Article IV).

name: Programme contribution to GDP or GDP growth (estimate)
definition: Contribution of a programme to the level of GDP, or to GDP growth over a stated period, in percent, as estimated by an official impact study. Use category= to say which.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Ministry of Finance impact study relayed in the Nicolatos report).

name: CBI inflows
definition: All money paid into a program in a period: government fund contributions, real-estate purchases and fees, as defined by the source
notes: Definitions differ between sources; check notes on each observation

name: Programme investment inflows as a share of foreign direct investment
definition: Investment brought in through a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme in a period as a percentage of gross foreign direct investment inflows in the same period, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS PE 627.128 (2018), p. 41 (Portugal: RBI inflows 'as much as 13 % of estimated gross foreign direct investment inflows for 2014', from IMF WP/15/93).

name: CBI inflows as a share of GDP
definition: cbi_inflows divided by nominal GDP
notes: Often an IMF staff estimate

name: Debt payments linked to CBI revenue
definition: Payments to creditors in a period whose amount is set by, or tied to, a programme's revenue under a debt agreement (e.g. Grenada's restructured international bonds, which entitle bondholders to a defined portion of the previous year's CBI revenue), as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 for the 'Bondholder CBI-related payments' line in IMF Grenada Article IV fiscal tables (CR 25/39, CR 26/9).

name: Debt payments linked to CBI revenue, percent of GDP
definition: cbi_linked_debt_payments divided by nominal GDP, as calculated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 (IMF Grenada Table 3b).

name: Jobs linked to programme investors
definition: Number of workers employed in the businesses of investors approved under a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme in a period, as stated by the source (may include existing jobs)
notes: added by research:egypt-jordan. Proposed by research:egypt-jordan for Jordan, whose routes are tied to job creation. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI inflows to an off-budget development fund, share of GDP
definition: CBI contributions paid to a national development fund outside the budget (e.g. St. Kitts SIDF) divided by GDP
notes: added by research:st-kitts-nevis. Not included in cbi_fiscal_revenue when the fund is off-budget Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Government spending on running a CBI programme
definition: Money the government appropriates or spends in a period on operating a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme (due diligence, consultancy, marketing, unit operating costs), as stated by the source. Status budget for appropriations, actual for spending. Use breakdown category= for the cost type.
notes: proposed by research:extract-kna-vut. Proposed by extract-kna-vut for St. Kitts appropriation warrants (2018 consultancy/operations and marketing; 2020-2021 due diligence and operating costs).

name: Programme running costs as a share of government spending
definition: Spending (or budgeted spending) on running a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme as a percentage of total government (recurrent) expenditure in the same period, as printed by the source. Use breakdown category= for the cost line.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma2. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma2 for the Dominica estimates, whose "analysis of recurrent expenditure" tables print object 354 (CBI marketing and due diligence) as a share of total recurrent expenditure (17.0% in 2018/19 to 11.1% in 2025/26).

name: Government spending on running a CBI programme, share of GDP
definition: cbi_programme_costs (e.g. CBI due diligence costs in the fiscal accounts) divided by GDP, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF St Kitts Article IV tables (General Government Fiscal Operations in percent of GDP, row "of which: CBI due diligence costs").

name: Staff working on a programme
definition: Staff (full-time equivalents) assigned to, or planned for, administering an investment-migration programme at a date or for a period; notes say whether existing or additional positions. Use breakdown category= for the office.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (additional FTEs in the USCIS EB-5 fee study).

name: Hotel rooms in programme real-estate projects
definition: Number of hotel rooms (keys) in a real-estate project approved, or approved in principle, as a qualifying investment under a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, as stated by the source (planned, under construction or completed: see status and notes). Use breakdown category= for the project.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for Dominica budget addresses and IMF reports, which describe CBI real-estate hotel projects (Range Kempinski, Jungle Bay, Anichi/Marriott, Tranquility Beach/Hilton Curio...) by room count. A planned count is status projection; an opened hotel actual.

name: Investment projects approved for a programme
definition: Number of real-estate or business projects approved as qualifying investments under a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, in a period. Use breakdown route=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-atg. Proposed by extract-atg (Antigua CIU overview table, 2015).

name: Programme projects covered by monitoring reports
definition: Number of programme investment projects covered by the monitoring reports counted in project_monitoring_reports, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1, paired with project_monitoring_reports.

name: Planned investment in approved programme projects
definition: Total investment planned (e.g. in the business plans) for the projects approved as qualifying investments under a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme, as stated by the source. Not money paid in by applicants. Use breakdown route= and region=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 for the Montenegrin government reports of 2021 (List of development projects in tourism). Status projection.

name: Investment through CBI and RBI schemes
definition: Total investment associated with CBI and RBI schemes combined
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Used for EU-wide EPRS estimates Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: People granted citizenship or residence through investor schemes
definition: Persons (incl. family members) obtaining citizenship or residence via CBI and RBI schemes combined
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Used for EU-wide EPRS estimates Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI real-estate investment inflows
definition: Money paid by CBI applicants into approved real-estate projects (e.g. developers' escrow accounts) in a period; not government revenue
notes: added by research:grenada. Complements cbi_fiscal_revenue; together roughly equal cbi_inflows Merged with cbi_real_estate_investment (research:saint-lucia). Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Programme real-estate purchases as a share of all property transactions
definition: Value of real-estate purchases by programme applicants as a percentage of the value of all real-estate transactions in the country, in a period, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-hkg. Proposed by extract-hkg (Hong Kong CIES, LegCo LCQ7 of 23 Feb 2011: about 1%).

name: CBI rejection rate
definition: Rejections divided by applications (or decisions) in a period, as defined by the source
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Often rejections in year / applications in year, not a cohort rate Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Public revenue lost through programme irregularities (estimate)
definition: Public revenue that an official audit or inquiry estimates was lost because of irregularities in a programme, e.g. reduced VAT wrongly applied to investors' homes or required contributions not collected
notes: added by research:cyprus. Use breakdown item=... for the type of loss. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI revenue missing or diverted
definition: Estimated CBI money that should have reached the state but did not (diverted, embezzled or never transferred), as estimated by an inquiry, prosecutor or auditor
notes: added by research:historical. Estimates by inquiries differ hugely; always check the source's method Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: CBI receipts saved, share of GDP
definition: Part of citizenship- or residence-by-investment receipts in a period that the government saves (keeps on deposit or uses to reduce net credit) rather than spends, divided by GDP, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-misc2. proposed by extract-cbi-misc2 for the IMF 2012 Article IV on Comoros (ECP windfall: 1.8% of GDP saved in 2012). No existing indicator covers savings out of CBI receipts as a flow.

name: Programme-linked share of bank remittances
definition: Percentage of all incoming bank remittances in a country in a period that are linked to the programme, as reported by the central bank or banks.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Central Bank of Cyprus governor testimony, Nicolatos report).

name: Suspicious-transaction reports concerning programme clients
definition: Reports filed by obliged entities (e.g. banks) with the financial intelligence unit concerning programme applicants or transactions, in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos report ch. 12).

name: CBI money transferred to a national development fund
definition: Amount of CBI contributions distributed to a dedicated national or sovereign development fund (e.g. Malta NDSF) in a period
notes: added by research:malta. Distributor-side (programme agency) and recipient-side (fund accounts) figures may differ in timing and scope. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI money transferred to government
definition: Money remitted by the CBI unit to the treasury or a government fund in a period (net fund contributions, bond proceeds, surplus transfers), as defined by the source
notes: added by research:saint-lucia. Components differ by source; see notes on each row. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Net income of the programme agency
definition: Net income of the agency running the programme in a period. Use breakdown category= for the measure the source prints: net_operating_income, net_income_before_tax, net_income_after_tax.
notes: proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other (Philippine Retirement Authority).

name: CBI unit revenue
definition: Operating revenue of the agency running the program (fees, retained share of fund contributions, administrative fees)
notes: added by research:saint-lucia. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: VAT on programme investors' property (computed)
definition: VAT on property bought by programme investors, computed by an audit at the rate named with item= (standard_rate_19pct or reduced_rate_5pct), for a stated group of properties.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Cyprus Audit Office special report 2022, reduced-VAT table).

name: Children granted citizenship
definition: Children of main applicants naturalised through the program
notes: added by research:turkey. Subset of dependants_naturalised Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Program citizenships revoked
definition: Persons (main applicants plus dependants unless noted) whose program citizenship was annulled or withdrawn
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions approved
definition: Petitions to remove the conditions on an investor's conditional permanent residence (e.g. US Form I-829) approved in a period, regardless of when filed. Approval gives unconditional permanent residence.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions denied
definition: Petitions to remove the conditions on an investor's conditional permanent residence (e.g. US Form I-829) denied in a period, regardless of when filed. Denial ends the conditional residence (subject to review in removal proceedings).
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions pending
definition: Petitions to remove the conditions on an investor's conditional permanent residence (e.g. US Form I-829) awaiting a decision at a date. A stock.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions decided
definition: Petitions to remove the conditions on an investor's conditional permanent residence (e.g. US Form I-829) completed in a period (approved plus denied, plus other closures where the source counts them), regardless of when filed.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 for the "Total Completions" column of the USCIS all-forms reports.

name: Petitions to remove residence conditions received
definition: Petitions filed by investors (e.g. US Form I-829) to remove the conditions on their conditional permanent residence, received in a period. The step after an initial investor petition and conditional residence; shows investors reaching the end of the conditional period.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Responses to a public consultation on a programme
definition: Number of written submissions, roundtables or other responses received in a government's public consultation or review of an investment-migration programme, as printed by the source. Use breakdown category= for the kind of response; unit says what is counted.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for the December 2020 Home Affairs BIIP review report (41 written submissions, nine roundtables).

name: Current account balance excluding CBI receipts
definition: External current account balance excluding CBI receipts recorded in it (e.g. CBI budgetary fees booked as services exports), as a share of GDP, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF St Kitts Article IV balance of payments tables.

name: Dependants approved
definition: Family members (dependants) granted residence or citizenship derived from a main applicant, in a period
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Dependants granted citizenship
definition: Family members (spouses, children, other dependants) naturalised through the program in a period, excluding main applicants
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Family members per application
definition: Average number of family members (dependants) included on each main application, in addition to the main applicant, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS EAVA PE 694.217 (2021), Annex II: 'an average of 1.61 family members are included on each application' across EU RBI programmes.

name: Family members per main applicant
definition: Average number of dependants (spouses, children) per main applicant granted status or a visa under a programme in a period, as computed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (EB-5: 1.81 derivatives per principal FY2014-2016).

name: Share of applicant documents verified
definition: Percentage of a type of supporting document (business ownership, qualifications, patents) that a processing office verifies with the issuing authority, as stated by the source at a date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for a Nov 2019 Home Affairs email (FOI FA 20/08/00701).

name: Due diligence reports, orders or interviews handled by a provider
definition: Number of due diligence reports, orders, subjects, requests or interviews that a programme's due diligence provider handled for the programme in a period, as printed by the provider or the unit. Use breakdown category= for the firm and the measure; the unit says what is counted.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-lca1. Proposed by extract-cbi-lca1 for the due diligence firms' sections of the Saint Lucia CIU annual reports 2023/24 and 2024/25 (S-RM, BDO, Exiger, FACT).

name: Eligibility applications approved
definition: Applications passing a preliminary eligibility or due-diligence stage that allows a full citizenship application (two-stage schemes)
notes: added by research:malta. Kept apart from applications_approved to avoid mixing stages. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Investment funds eligible for a programme
definition: Number of funds or collective investment vehicles licensed or registered whose units qualified as a programme investment, at a date or over a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Nicolatos report ch. 10, CySEC).

name: Enquiries received by the programme
definition: Number of enquiries (phone, email, visits, as the source counts them) received by the programme authority from prospective applicants in a period. Not applications.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-hkg1. Proposed by extract-cbi-hkg1 for the Hong Kong New CIES press release of 7 Jan 2025 ('Number of enquiries Nearly 7 000' in the first 10 months).

name: EU aid to Sugar Protocol countries
definition: EU funds for accompanying measures for Sugar Protocol countries (all countries unless noted)
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: EU reference price, raw sugar
definition: Legislated EU reference price for standard-quality raw sugar, per tonne, by marketing year
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: EU reference price, white sugar
definition: Legislated EU reference price for standard-quality white sugar, per tonne, by marketing year
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Council Regulation (EC) No 318/2006 Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Expressions of interest submitted
definition: Expressions of interest (EOIs) for an investor visa held or submitted in an invitation system (e.g. Australia's SkillSelect) at a date or in a period, before any invitation to apply. Notes say whether a stock at a date or a flow.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for SIV EOIs by nominating government (FOI FA 20/08/00701, EOIs as at 31 March 2019).

name: Valid residence permits of investors' family members (stock)
definition: Residence permits valid on a date held by family members of programme investors (first grants plus renewals), excluding main investors
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. Complements investor_permits_valid; sum of the two equals residence_permits_valid when the source prints all three. Greece has the narrower family_permits_valid_initial / _renewal. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Valid first-grant permits of investors' family members (stock)
definition: Valid initial permits held by family members of investors
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Valid renewed permits of investors' family members (stock)
definition: Valid renewed/reissued permits held by family members of investors
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Overall balance excluding CBI revenue (amount)
definition: Central government overall balance excluding citizenship- or residence-by-investment revenue, in currency, as calculated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica Article IV statements of operations in EC$ ("Overall balance (excl. CBI)"). The amount counterpart of fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Fiscal balance excluding CBI proceeds
definition: General government overall balance excluding CBI proceeds, as a share of GDP
notes: added by research:malta. Usually an IMF staff figure. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Fraud tips and complaints about a programme received
definition: Tips, complaints and referrals received by an authority (e.g. a securities regulator) about possible fraud connected with an investment-migration programme, in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (GAO-15-696: over 100 SEC tips Jan 2013-Jan 2015).

name: Enforcement actions over investor-programme fraud
definition: Number of civil or criminal enforcement actions brought by an authority (e.g. US SEC civil actions, DOJ prosecutions) alleging fraud or securities violations connected with an investment-migration programme, cumulative to a date or in a period. Say which authority and whether administrative proceedings are included.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Open fraud investigations involving the programme
definition: Number of investigations by law-enforcement or programme integrity units concerning a residence- or citizenship-by-investment programme that are open at a date.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Age of programme participants at a grant
definition: Age (range, with value the youngest and value_high the oldest, or an average if notes say so) of people at the time they were granted residence or citizenship through, or after holding status under, an investment-migration programme, as printed by the source. Use breakdown category= for the grant (e.g. citizenship_grant).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-sgp2. Proposed by extract-cbi-sgp2 for Singapore written answer of 1 Aug 2017 (67 GIP PRs granted citizenship at ages 25 to 58). Age-bracket shares stay in applicant_profile_share.

name: Share of programme grants by region of the investment
definition: Percentage of a programme's grants (visas, permits or citizenships) in a period whose qualifying investment is located in a given region or province, as printed by the source. Never calculated by us. Use breakdown region= (ISO 3166-2 code where possible) and route=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-esp1. Proposed by extract-cbi-esp1 for Spanish real-estate golden visas by province (184/41377 table of destinations; MEYSS 2015 Cuadro 5; 2024 government releases: six provinces 90%). Nationality shares stay in applicant_nationality_share.

name: Programme applicants identified as high risk
definition: Applicants or approved persons of a programme whom an authority, investigation or study identifies as high risk (politically exposed, sanctioned, convicted or facing charges), in a period; use breakdown category= for the type. Not the same as irregular_naturalisations_detected (grants found to breach the rules).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS EAVA PE 694.217 (2021), Annex II p. 29: Cyprus, 97 high-risk individuals out of 2,500 applications (54 PEPs, 43 convicted).

name: Dwellings sold to foreigners (proxy)
definition: Number of dwellings sold to foreign nationals in a period, from land-registry data. A context/proxy series, not a count of CBI applicants or purchases.
notes: added by research:turkey. Turkey: TurkStat from TKGM; excludes persons of Turkish origin and those under Law 4112. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Immigrant visas issued abroad
definition: Immigrant visas issued by consular posts abroad under the programme's visa categories in a period, principal investors plus derivative spouses and children. Excludes adjustments of status by people already inside the country.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. US EB-5: State Department Report of the Visa Office, Table VI (Part IV), '5th Total'. Counted by foreign state of chargeability (normally country of birth). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Change in investment certificates issued (percent, as stated)
definition: Percentage change in the number of investment certificates (or certified investors) issued under a programme between a period and an earlier period, as stated by the source. Never calculated by us. Notes say the comparison period and what is counted.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-pan1. Proposed by extract-cbi-pan1 for MICI Panama (27 July 2023: 'un incremento de 100% en comparación con el mismo periodo del año anterior'). Companion to investment_certificates_issued; analogous to applications_received_change_pct.

name: Investment eligibility certificates issued
definition: Main applicants who obtained (or became entitled to) the certificate confirming a qualifying investment, a step before the citizenship decision
notes: added by research:turkey. Turkey: 'uygunluk belgesi' / 'Taşınmaz Yatırımı Tespit Belgesi' Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Investment certificates in one period as a percentage of another (as stated)
definition: Investment certificates (or certified investors) of one period or sub-group expressed as a percentage of those of another stated period or group, as printed by the source (e.g. certificates in July-October 2024 as a share of all 2023 certificates, or the share of a year's certified investors who applied in a sub-period). Never calculated by us. Notes state both bases.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-pan1. Proposed by extract-cbi-pan1 for MICI Panama press releases (13 Dec 2024: 84% of 2023's certifications issued in July-October 2024; 5 Feb 2025: about 70% of 2024's certified investors applied in July-December 2024).

name: Share of investment certificates by route
definition: Investment certificates issued in a period for one investment route (real estate, deposit, securities...) as a percentage of all certificates issued in that period, as reported by the issuing authority
notes: added by research:panama. Use with breakdown route=...; companion to investment_certificates_issued. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor funds misused or misappropriated (per case)
definition: Amount that an authority (regulator, prosecutor or court) alleges or finds was misused, diverted or misappropriated from programme investors in a specific case, as stated by that authority
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. Case-level, not a programme total. Notes must say whether the amount is an allegation (status claim) or adjudicated (court finding, plea, restitution order). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Valid residence permits of main investors (stock)
definition: Valid permits held by main investors (first grant plus renewal), excluding family members
notes: added by research:greece. Closest proxy for the number of investors holding the status on a date. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Valid first-grant permits of main investors (stock)
definition: Valid permits of main investors still in their first (initial) permit period
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Valid first-grant main-investor permits held by Chinese nationals
definition: investor_permits_valid_initial restricted to nationals of China
notes: added by research:greece. Nationality breakdowns as separate indicators so they do not collide with totals. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Valid first-grant main-investor permits held by Turkish nationals
definition: investor_permits_valid_initial restricted to nationals of Turkey
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Valid renewed permits of main investors (stock)
definition: Valid permits of main investors that have been renewed or reissued
notes: added by research:greece. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Investor visa applications
definition: Applications for an entry visa that is a required first step before an investor residence permit (e.g. Hungary's guest investor visa)
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Kept apart from applications_received (permit stage). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor visas issued
definition: Investor entry visas granted (first stage before the residence permit)
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investors per pooled-investment entity
definition: Average or median number of programme investors per project, enterprise or intermediary (e.g. EB-5 new commercial enterprise or regional center), as computed by the source. breakdown category= names the entity and statistic. Also used for distribution statistics (min, max, mean, median) of investors per regional center from small-entity samples.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3.

name: Main applicants whose program citizenship was revoked
definition: Main applicants (investors) whose citizenship or qualifying investment certificate was annulled or withdrawn
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Invitations to apply issued
definition: Invitations to apply for an investor visa issued to people who lodged an expression of interest (and, where relevant, were nominated), in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus1. proposed by extract-cbi-aus1 for Australian SIV invitations (FOI FA 20/08/00701).

name: Share of programme grants found not to meet the rules
definition: Percentage of approved applicants (or passports issued) that an audit or inquiry found did not meet a programme condition (e.g. no qualifying residence, investment not made), in a period, as printed by the source. Use breakdown category= for the condition.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS EAVA PE 694.217 (2021), p. 30, citing the Cyprus Attorney General's inquiry: 12% without a permanent residence, 8% without the required investment.

name: Irregular naturalisations detected
definition: Persons found by prosecutors or authorities to have obtained program citizenship irregularly (e.g. via sham sales or inflated valuations), whether or not yet revoked
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Irregular investor residence grants detected
definition: Persons found by an auditor, prosecutor or other authority to have obtained investor-linked residence irregularly (e.g. by a sham change of status to company partner), in or up to the stated period, whether or not the residence was withdrawn.
notes: proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other for the Oman State Audit Institution finding (2024 Society Summary, p. 40). Residence counterpart of irregular_naturalisations_detected.

name: Long-term ("golden") residence permits issued, all categories
definition: Long-term residence permits (e.g. UAE golden visas) issued in a period across all eligibility categories (investors, entrepreneurs, talents, professionals, students, and family members if the source includes them); not limited to investors, and not distinguishing first grants from renewals unless noted
notes: added by research:uae. Use residence_permits_issued (with breakdown route=...) for investor-only counts. UAE figures are mostly Dubai (breakdown emirate=dubai). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Share of lump-sum taxpayers or revenue in a group of regions
definition: Percentage of all lump-sum taxpayers, or of lump-sum tax revenue, located in a stated canton or group of cantons, as printed by the source. Use category=taxpayers or a revenue category, and region= (several codes joined with +). Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the 2011 Federal Council message (73.9% of lump-sum taxpayers and 77.8% of cantonal and communal revenue in VD, VS, TI and GE).

name: Tax paid per lump-sum taxpayer (lowest, highest or average)
definition: Lowest, highest or average tax collected from one person taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis in a period, all levels of government unless noted, as printed by the source. Use breakdown category=lowest, highest or average. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the FDK surveys of Swiss cantons (lowest and highest lump-sum tax 2008-2018; average CHF 180,162 in 2018).

name: Tax revenue from lump-sum (expenditure-based) taxation
definition: Tax collected in a period from people taxed on a lump-sum or expenditure basis, all levels of government unless noted.
notes: proposed by research:europe-rest.

name: People taxed on a lump-sum (expenditure) basis
definition: Number of taxpayers assessed on their living expenses instead of income and wealth (e.g. Swiss Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand) at a date, usually year-end. A stock.
notes: proposed by research:europe-rest. For tax-residence regimes for wealthy foreigners. Not a count of permits.

name: Main applicants approved
definition: Main applicants granted citizenship or residence in a period. First grants only; renewals excluded unless noted.

name: Projected minimum investment amount
definition: A government projection of what a programme's minimum investment amount would be after future automatic (e.g. inflation) adjustments, under stated scenarios. Not a programme term in force.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (EB-5 Modernization rule Table 4).

name: CBI development-fund assets as a share of GDP
definition: Accumulated assets of a CBI-financed national development fund divided by GDP
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI development-fund surplus as a share of GDP
definition: Income minus spending of a national development fund financed by CBI contributions in a period, divided by GDP, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF surplus 2007-2013).

name: Subsidised credit backed by a CBI-financed development fund, percent of GDP
definition: Credit facilities that banks extend at below-market rates against zero- or low-interest deposits placed by a national development fund financed by citizenship- or residence-by-investment money (e.g. St Kitts SIDF), as a stock at a date (breakdown category=facilities_outstanding), or the annual interest subsidy they imply (category=annual_subsidy), in percent of GDP, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl3. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl3 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF facilities 'about 1.5 percent of GDP by end-2013', subsidies 'about 0.05 percent of GDP per year'). No existing indicator covers NDF-backed lending.

name: CBI development-fund spending as a share of GDP
definition: Spending of a national development fund financed by CBI contributions (e.g. St Kitts SIDF) in a period, divided by GDP, as stated by the source. Use breakdown category= for components (transfers to government, grants, direct programmes, net-of-budget presentations).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-kna1. Proposed by extract-cbi-kna1 for IMF WP/15/93 Box 5 (SIDF operations 2007-2013). Companion to ndf_income_pct_gdp.

name: CBI development-fund income as a share of GDP
definition: Income of a national development fund financed by CBI contributions (e.g. SIDF), divided by GDP
notes: added by research:context-timeline. Separate from cbi_fiscal_revenue, which covers the central budget Merged with cbi_ndf_income_pct_gdp (research:st-kitts-nevis); may include investment income, see row notes. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: CBI passports issued
definition: Passports issued to people who got citizenship through the programme (main applicants and dependants) in a period, as reported by the programme unit
notes: added by research:antigua-barbuda. Close to persons_naturalised but counts passports; Antigua's CIU reports it by year, and the yearly series changes between report vintages. Reviewed 2026-09-28. Merged with cbi_passports_issued (research:context-timeline). Passports can exceed persons naturalised (renewals).

name: Valid permanent residence permits (stock)
definition: Number of people holding a valid permanent residence permit on a date, as reported by the source, for the categories the source covers (which may include non-investor categories such as professionals or retirees)
notes: proposed by research:africa-indian-ocean. Proposed by research:africa-indian-ocean for Mauritius (EDB annual report).

name: People granted citizenship
definition: Persons naturalised through the program in a period (main applicants plus dependants unless noted)

name: Approved investor petitions awaiting a visa number
definition: Approved investor immigrant petitions (e.g. US Forms I-526/I-526E) whose principal beneficiaries have not yet obtained permanent residence because no visa number is available under annual or per-country limits, at a date. Principal investors only, no family members.
notes: added by research:usa-eb5. added by research:usa-eb5. Stock at a date; measures the visa backlog, not demand. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Primary balance excluding CBI revenue (amount)
definition: Central government primary balance excluding citizenship- or residence-by-investment revenue, in currency, as calculated by the source. Use breakdown category=excl_natural_disaster_cost when the source also excludes a natural-disaster cost provision.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-dma1. Proposed by extract-cbi-dma1 for IMF Dominica Article IV statements of operations in EC$ ("Primary balance (excl. CBI)"). The amount counterpart of primary_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Primary balance excluding CBI revenue, percent of GDP
definition: Central government primary balance excluding citizenship- or residence-by-investment revenue, as a share of GDP, as calculated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-grd1. Proposed by extract-cbi-grd1 for IMF Grenada 2016 Article IV Table 1 ('Primary balance (excl. CBI revenues)'). The primary-balance counterpart of fiscal_balance_excl_cbi_pct_gdp.

name: Processing or screening time, in days
definition: Time within which a programme authority decides (or screens) an application, in days, as printed by the source at a date; use value_high for a range or an extendable maximum. Say in notes which stage is timed (due diligence, whole application) and whether it is a maximum, typical or advertised time.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EU legal acts on Vanuatu that state times in days (Regulation (EU) 2025/11: screening and due diligence 'a maximum of 14 days, extendable to 30 days'; Implementing Regulation 2022/693, fn 5: an agent's '14 to 45 days'). processing_time_months is in months and converting days would be a calculation.

name: Processing time goal
definition: Target average time, in days, set in law or by the authority for deciding a type of application (a goal, not a measured time). Status budget.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (sec. 106(b) of the US EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022). Use breakdown form=.

name: Processing time for a decision
definition: Time the programme authority publishes (or an official body reports) for deciding a type of application, in months, at a date; say in notes whether it is a median, an average or the time within which most cases are decided.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa1. Proposed by extract-cbi-usa1 (USCIS EB-5 wait times for Forms I-526, I-829 and I-924, January 2015, in DHS OIG 2015). Use breakdown form=.

name: Share of applications by processing-time band
definition: Percentage of applications (approved, unless noted) decided within a band of time from filing to decision. Use category= for the band.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-cyp1. proposed by extract-cbi-cyp1 (Cyprus Audit Office special report 2022, p. 30 pie chart).

name: Processing time for a decision (weeks)
definition: Time the programme authority publishes (or an official body reports) for deciding a type of application, in weeks, as printed, at a date; use value_high for a range. Say in notes whether it is an average, a target or an advertised typical time.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish IIP guidelines of January 2018 ('on average 16 to 18 weeks'); companion to processing_time_months and processing_time_days, since converting weeks would be a calculation.

name: Programme participants who left
definition: People or households in an investment-migration or wealthy-resident regime who left the country or region in a period (for example after the regime was abolished there), as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-che1. proposed by extract-cbi-che1 for the 2011 Federal Council message (92 of 201 lump-sum-taxed households left Zurich by end-2010 after cantonal abolition).

name: Programme filings approved (other forms)
definition: Filings under a programme's forms other than the main investor petition, the petition to remove conditions and intermediary designation applications (e.g. EB-5 project applications I-956F, annual statements I-924A/I-956G, bona fides I-956H, promoter registrations I-956K) approved in a period. Use breakdown form=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4; companion of programme_filings_received.

name: Programme filings denied (other forms)
definition: Filings under a programme's other forms (as for programme_filings_approved) denied in a period. Use breakdown form=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4.

name: Programme filings pending (other forms)
definition: Filings under a programme's other forms (as for programme_filings_approved) awaiting a decision at a date. A stock. Use breakdown form=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (USCIS all-forms "Pending").

name: Programme filings decided (other forms)
definition: Filings under a programme's other forms (as for programme_filings_approved) completed in a period (approvals plus denials, plus other closures where the source counts them). Use breakdown form=.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa4. proposed by extract-cbi-usa4 (USCIS all-forms "Total Completions").

name: Programme filings received (all or other forms)
definition: Filings received (or forecast) in a period under a programme's forms other than the main investor petition and the petition to remove conditions: project/investment approval applications, intermediary annual statements, bona fides attestations, promoter registrations, petition amendments, or all programme forms together. Use breakdown form= for the form; empty breakdown = the source's all-form total.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 for the EB-5 fee rules (Forms I-527, I-956F, I-956G, I-956H, I-956K and all-form totals). Investor petitions stay in applications_received, I-829 in conditions_removal_petitions_received, I-956 in regional_center_applications_received.

name: Average characteristic of programme migrants
definition: Average (mean) of a characteristic of people admitted through a programme or of their businesses, other than income (e.g. years of prior business experience, businesses owned, ownership share, personal income tax paid), as printed by the source; category= says what is averaged and unit gives its unit. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 evaluation of the federal Business Immigration Program (survey and IMDB averages for Investor class immigrants).

name: Income of programme migrants
definition: Typical annual income (average, median or approximate, as the source states) of people admitted through a programme, in a period, as printed. Use breakdown applicant= and category= for the group (e.g. age band).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the 2023 Review of the Migration System, Figure 49 (approximate incomes of Investor visa primary applicants by age, ABS Census 2016).

name: Programme share of a combined budget or cost
definition: Percentage of the costs of a wider government programme or budget line attributable to the investor programme or class, in a period, as printed. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for the CIC 2014 BIP evaluation (Investor class 56.6% of BIP costs 2006/07-2011/12).

name: Programme grants as a share of all grants of the same status
definition: Percentage of all first-time residence permits (category=first_residence_permits) or all naturalisations (category=naturalisations) granted in a country in a period that were granted through the investor programme, as printed by the source. Never calculated by us.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-intl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-intl2 for EPRS PE 627.128 (2018), Table 1 (RBI permits as % of all first-time residence permits) and p. 18 (share of naturalisations through the CBI scheme).

name: Programme holders switching to another immigration route
definition: People whose previous permission was under the investment-migration programme and who were granted permission in another immigration category (leaving the programme route for another status) in a period. Use breakdown category=to_<new category>.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-gbr1. proposed by extract-cbi-gbr1 for UK Home Office Exe_D02 (extensions by previous category of leave, 2015-2020).

name: Monitoring reports on programme projects adopted
definition: Number of independent monitoring (factual-situation) reports on programme investment projects adopted or accepted by the government or programme authority, cumulative to a date or in a period, as stated by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-mne1. Proposed by extract-cbi-mne1 (Montenegro: Government adoption of independent controllers' reports on tourism development projects). The number of projects covered goes in cbi_projects_monitored.

name: Project proposals declined
definition: Number of investment project proposals declined as qualifying investments for a programme in a period. Use breakdown route= for the type.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 (NZTE acceptable-investment decisions for Active Investor Plus).

name: Project proposals awaiting a decision
definition: Number of investment project proposals (projects that investors nominate, as distinct from investor applications) submitted to a programme and undergoing or awaiting assessment at a date. A stock.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl2. proposed by extract-cbi-irl2 for the Irish IIP wind-down, where about 90 project proposals were still undecided in July and December 2025 alongside 1,400-1,600 investor applications (applications_pending counts main applicants, so it does not fit).

name: Project proposals received
definition: Number of investment project proposals (businesses or funds seeking to become qualifying investments for a programme, as distinct from investor applications) submitted in a period. Use breakdown route= for the type.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 for NZTE's assessments of businesses and managed funds applying to be acceptable Active Investor Plus investments (MBIE briefing, Oct 2024). Companions: cbi_projects_approved, project_proposals_declined, project_proposals_withdrawn, project_proposals_pending (proposed by extract-cbi-irl2).

name: Project proposals withdrawn
definition: Number of investment project proposals withdrawn by the proposer before a decision, in a period. Use breakdown route= for the type.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 (NZTE acceptable-investment decisions for Active Investor Plus).

name: Properties acquired for citizenship
definition: Number of real estate units bought under the program's real estate route
notes: added by research:turkey. Reviewed 2026-09-28.

name: Property purchases by programme participants (outside the programme)
definition: Number of property purchases in a period by people who obtained residence or citizenship through an investment-migration programme, made outside any real-estate investment route of the programme, as stated by the source. Use breakdown category= for the property type.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-sgp2. Proposed by extract-cbi-sgp2 for Singapore written answer of 9 May 2022 (21 landed purchases 2004-2021 by citizens who first got PR through the GIP). Not properties_acquired_for_cbi, which counts purchases under a programme's real-estate route.

name: Extra financing cost of investor-programme bonds
definition: Estimated additional cost to the state of borrowing through investor-programme bonds compared with ordinary market or official borrowing over the same period
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Always an estimate; method in notes. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor-programme bonds outstanding
definition: Face value of government bonds issued for a residence- or citizenship-by-investment programme and not yet repaid, at a date
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Stock at a date; face value, not cash raised (discount bonds). Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor-programme bonds repaid
definition: Face value of investor-programme government bonds repaid by the state at maturity in a period
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Investor-programme bonds sold (count)
definition: Number of bonds, bond packages or investors subscribing bonds under an investor programme in a period, as counted by the source (see unit)
notes: added by research:hungary-latvia. added by research:hungary-latvia. Units differ: bond pieces vs one package per investor; check unit and notes. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Businesses receiving programme investment
definition: Number of businesses that receive investor capital under a residence- or citizenship-by-investment programme (e.g. US EB-5 new commercial enterprises and job-creating entities), at a date or approved in a period; use breakdown category= for the entity type. Intermediaries such as regional centers are counted in regional_centers_designated. Includes counts of new commercial enterprises referenced in petitions filed in a period and DHS forecasts (status projection).
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 for DHS EB-5 integrity NPRM (2026).

name: Programme capital per project (distribution)
definition: Investor-programme capital (or total capital for blended projects) per investment project, as a distribution statistic (median, mean, maximum) over the projects in the source's sample. Not a total.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (DHS small-entity analysis, 1,402 EB-5 projects FY 2018-2022).

name: Programme deposits held (stock)
definition: Refundable deposits of programme members held by the agency or its depository banks at a date.
notes: proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other (PRA restricted visa deposits / trust liabilities).

name: Net programme deposits
definition: Refundable programme deposits brought in by new members minus deposits returned to leaving members, in a period, as printed by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other. The PRA calls it net foreign currency generated from visa deposits. Note: an existing row from phl-pra-ar-2017 records a net figure under rbi_investment_total.

name: Programme deposits returned on exit
definition: Refundable programme deposits (e.g. SRRV visa deposits) paid back to members who left the programme or died, in a period.
notes: proposed by research:extract-other. Proposed by extract-other (Philippine Retirement Authority visa-deposit tables). Companion to rbi_investment_total (gross deposits brought in).

name: Estimated economic benefit of a programme
definition: Economic benefit of a citizenship- or residence-by-investment programme to the host economy as modelled by an evaluation (e.g. value of investment net of repayment, or tax and spending by investors), in a period. Always status estimate; use breakdown category= for the component and gross/net, and value_high for a range.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-irl1. proposed by extract-cbi-irl1 for the Irish Department of Justice interim evaluation of the IIP (2017), Table 6.6 (gross €74.8m and €11.4m; net ranges).

name: Existing investments of people identified as eligible
definition: Official estimate of the investments already held by the people identified as eligible for a residence scheme; not new investment attributable to the scheme
notes: added by research:uae. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: People identified as eligible for an investor residence scheme
definition: Number of people the authorities say qualify for (or are targeted by) a residence-by-investment or long-term residence scheme at a date; not permits issued
notes: added by research:uae. A target or eligibility pool, often announced at launch. Reviewed 2026-10-02.

name: Revenue of programme businesses (distribution)
definition: Revenue or estimated income of businesses involved in a programme (intermediaries such as EB-5 regional centers, or project companies such as new commercial enterprises and job-creating entities), as a distribution statistic over the source's sample. Not a total. Use breakdown category= for entity type, sample and statistic.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-usa3. proposed by extract-cbi-usa3 (DHS small-entity analysis, commercial database matches). Differs from rbi_intermediary_income (programme-wide profit or income).

name: Modelled lifetime fiscal impact per programme migrant
definition: Average net fiscal impact (government revenue minus attributable spending over the lifetime) of one migrant admitted through a programme, as modelled by an official body. Per person, not a programme total. Always status estimate.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-aus2. proposed by extract-cbi-aus2 for the 2023 Review of the Migration System, Figure 24 (Treasury FIONA model: BIIP -$80k per person).

name: Follow-on investment by programme investors
definition: Investment made by residence- or citizenship-by-investment migrants outside (in addition to) the investment their visa requires, in a period, as estimated or reported by the source.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-nzl2. Proposed by extract-cbi-nzl2 for the BERL (2017) estimate of NZ$1.7 billion follow-on investment by Investor 1 and 2 migrants 2009-2017, cited in MBIE Cabinet papers and briefings. Distinct from rbi_investment_total (required qualifying investment).

name: Investor-programme funds allocated to regional funds
definition: Money raised by a government-run investor programme that is allocated or transferred to regional (provincial, territorial) funds in a period, and amounts those funds placed in a stated use (category=), as printed. Use breakdown destination= for the region.
notes: proposed by research:extract-cbi-can1. proposed by extract-cbi-can1 for Table 5.8 of the CIC 2014 evaluation (federal IIP allocations by province 2007-2011).

name: Implied annual cost of investor capital
